column1: # Key no. 25 sheet (BnF fr. 3995 f. 51r, Gallica btv1b525085665 canvas f104, viewed rotated 90 deg via IIIF), "Villes" and
# "Provinces" blocks. Read 11 Nov 2026 (second pass). [V] = read on the image; [?] = uncertain letter.
# The city codes continue the Roman-numeral series of the "Noms generaux" (x-lvii). From 80 the sheet writes old French
# "quatre-vingts": iiij with xx above (iiij^xx = 80), which looks like "m" with "xx" above. The earlier note that these
# are "m"-series codes is a misreading of iiij (four minims).
